title: Terracotta plate
date: ca. 1750–1600 BCE (Middle Minoan III, the period of the Phaistos Disc)
museum: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 07.232.22, Gift of American Exploration Society, 1907
notes: The plate's floor, unwarped from the oblique photograph to a circle, cropped square (1600px) and its overall shading flattened; colour and grain unchanged.

title: Bronze disk mirror
museum: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 11.212.35, Rogers Fund, 1911
notes: The inscribed circle of the mirror's patinated face, cropped square (1500px), shading flattened and the patina's relief contrast softened so engraved type reads on it.
